message: In Rohin’s reported raw-child handshake, an unfinished step is carried forward and checked; what, if anything, has actually happened with your multiplication? Would thinking clarify why your draft alternates between 1305 and 1345, or would a small attempt offer better evidence, and which thinking or doing step do you choose to undertake yourself instead of returning another questionnaire? What observation would change that choice, and what finding, uncertainty, evidence source, and unfinished step will you carry forward?
